speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To help me understand your condition better, how many days have passed since you finished your antibiotics?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: The fever and flank pain persisting despite improved sinus symptoms suggest a complication. Have you noticed any changes in the frequency, color, or odor of your urine, or have you experienced pain when urinating?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The clinical presentation of fever, flank pain, and fatigue following antibiotic treatment for sinusitis, combined with the development of a rash during amoxicillin therapy and subsequent improvement on cephalexin, strongly suggests a urinary tract infection that progressed to kidney infection, likely triggered by an allergic reaction to the initial antibiotic.
